headline: MIA @ TOR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIA 3.16 at TOR 4.48, with a projected total of 7.64. Batter research is strongest for Xavier Edwards, Otto Lopez, Jesús Sánchez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Myles Straw, Kazuma Okamoto because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
